newsitem.title: POLAND: EBRD, Polish BDK bank in investment venture - PAP.
newsitem.headline: EBRD, Polish BDK bank in investment venture - PAP.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and Poland's Bank Depozytowo-Kredytowy SA (BDK), on Thursday formed an investment company to help troubled firms, PAP news agency said.

PAP said EBRD and BDK each contributed $10 million for a 50 percent stake in the new firm, named SRP Investment, and said they might increase its capital if the restructuring programme for companies proved a success.
BDK spokesman Marek Gedek was quoted as saying: "This firm will involve itself with companies which are suffering because they lack capital."
SRP Investment is the first firm created through the Stabilisation-Restructuring-Privatisation programme created by EBRD and the Polish government, PAP said.
In late 1996 the Lublin-based BDK became part of a banking group around large state-owned bank Pekao SA.
